row.team_price_text: Reviews & UGC Pro: from $119/month (flat, by monthly order volume)
row.evidence: Yotpo documents SAML single sign-on on all plans (set up through your Customer Success Manager), but no SCIM or automated user provisioning appears in its pricing, support centre or developer reference.
row.notes: New row. None by absence (rule 5): searched the pricing pages, the support-centre index, the developer API index and the Okta catalogue. Pricing is flat per store and scales with monthly order volume (billed monthly; annual available): Reviews & UGC Free $0 (50 orders), Starter from $15/month, Pro from $119/month, Premium and Enterprise custom. Teammates are a Pro, Premium and Enterprise feature, so Pro is the team plan. The SSO article lists 'All plans' and needs an Org key from Yotpo; SAML works with any IdP. Okta's OIN Yotpo app is SWA only.
